# RS Handelsvertretung

> Independent commercial agent in Menziken, Switzerland (sole proprietorship of Rajinder Singh, founded 2026). Commission only, paid by the seller.
> Two services: (1) tenders and purchase requests in Europe for manufacturers without a local office – full reading of the file, all contract costs upfront, help with forms and submission; (2) representation of selected product lines to Swiss business customers.

- Contact: info@rshandelsvertretung.com · Languages: German, French, English, Hindi, Punjabi
- Not a distributor, not a service partner, no promise of award. The manufacturer submits the bid and contracts directly.
